## Known biases

Costs are for interruptions up to 24 hours only (long outages are outside the survey-based method); the model is a survey-based econometric model (4,156 residential and 5,287 non-residential responses in 2.2); the underlying equations and coefficients are copyrighted and licensed, not published. The 2.0-versus-2.2 memorandum shows estimates changed between versions.
